LanguageData.TMM_TrafficTradeDesc: Open trade with this passing faction caravan using its real carried cargo.\n\n{0}
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficAttackDesc: Ambush this passing faction caravan on the road and seize its cargo. Relations with the faction will plummet.\n\n{0}
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficAttackConfirm: Attack the passing {0} caravan?\n\nThis will make {0} hostile and start an immediate road ambush against its crew.
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficNoNegotiator: No colonist capable of social negotiation in this caravan.
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficNoTraderKind: This caravan has no compatible trader profile.
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficAttackBlockedGone: The caravan is no longer here.
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficAttackBlockedTruce: {0} is under a temporary truce. Attacking now would break the story agreement.
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficAttackBlockedDiplomacy: Relations with {0} cannot be broken right now, so there would be no fight.
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficAttackBlockedNoTile: There is no open ground nearby for a battle. Move off the settlement tile first.
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficAttackFailed: The ambush could not be set up. Both caravans stay as they were.
LanguageData.TMM_TrafficTradeStale: The deal fell through: the caravans have parted or the goods have changed. Nothing was exchanged.
LanguageData.TMM_VehicleUnloadHomeDesc: The crew gets out and haulers carry the cargo to storage. Cargo without a storage place is put down near the colony.
LanguageData.TMM_VehicleUnloadHomeActive: The vehicle is being unloaded. Press to repeat the order, for example if the crew could not get out or enemies are near.
